h1: Myanmar tourist visa from the UK

sections.heading: Do you need a Myanmar tourist visa?
sections.text: British passport holders need a visa to visit Myanmar (Burma), which can be applied for online as an eVisa.

sections.heading: What a Myanmar tourist visa covers
sections.text: A Myanmar tourist visa is for holidays, sightseeing and visiting family or friends in Myanmar. It doesn't cover business meetings or paid work. If you're travelling for business, see our [Myanmar business visa](/myanmar-business-visa-uk/) page.

sections.heading: UK residents on other passports
sections.text: UK residents on other passports usually apply the same way.

sections.heading: Myanmar tourist visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and handle Myanmar tourist visa applications for travellers across the UK, entirely online. Before you travel, read the UK government's [foreign travel advice](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice) for Myanmar.

sections.heading: Before you travel to Myanmar
sections.text:
Check the UK government’s [travel advice for Myanmar](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/myanmar) before you book, and again shortly before you go. It covers safety, local laws, health risks and the latest entry rules.

- Passport: most countries expect it to be valid for at least six months after you arrive, with blank pages for stamps. If yours is close to expiry, renew it first.
- Health: check the NHS fitfortravel website for Myanmar at least eight weeks before you travel, in case you need vaccinations or malaria tablets. Some countries ask for a yellow fever certificate if you’ve recently been somewhere with yellow fever.
- Insurance: take out travel insurance that covers medical treatment and getting you home, and check it’s valid for Myanmar.
- Bookings: carry copies of your return ticket and accommodation, as border officers can ask to see them.

We go through the entry requirements for your passport when we prepare your application, so you know exactly what to carry.

faqs.q: Can I visit family on a Myanmar tourist visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Visiting family or friends is covered by the Myanmar tourist visa.

faqs.q: Can I work in Myanmar on a Myanmar tourist visa?
faqs.a: No. Working needs a work visa or permit. Contact us and we’ll explain the options.

faqs.q: How long does a Myanmar tourist visa take?
faqs.a: Usually a few working days, but processing times vary. Apply at least a week before you travel, and earlier in busy seasons.

faqs.q: Do I need travel insurance for Myanmar?
faqs.a: We strongly recommend it. Choose a policy that covers medical treatment and repatriation, and check it’s valid for your destination before you go.
